reply_text:
I've replied to Hollis in your DM thread. Everything came from Central channels Hollis is a member of:

  Main contact: Linnea Halvorsen. Pree posted this in #central-team on 14 Oct.

  Deadline: 15 August. Tobias posted this in #central-random on 14 Oct but didn't say which year. 15 Aug 2026 had already passed, so I told him at the time I was reading it as 15 August 2027 and asked him to correct me. I found no reply from him, so I asked Hollis to check with Tobias before putting the date in the handover.

  Ticket for the West yard Door 2 double-booking: #8841. Tobias flagged it to support in #central-random on 13 Oct after flatbeds checking in early at the kiosk double-booked the door. In that message he named "the Plains depots" and Hollis called it "Tobias's dealer account", not Marrow Fieldworks. So it being the Marrow Fieldworks account is my assumption, and I said so in the reply.

There are no Marrow Fieldworks files in the share to check these against.
